data.summary:
Results-driven Technology Change & Transformation professional with 15+ years of experience spanning IT controls, operational risk, reconciliation and Billing (ORMB) platform transformation, and cross-regional programs at BNY Mellon, Citibank, and Webster Bank. Proven track record continually reassessing operational risk against regulatory requirements, operating procedures, and technology change; driving AI-enabled automation and process re-engineering that lifts throughput and consistency without compromising control quality; and producing requirement, training, and process- education material for cross-functional teams. Adept at partnering with Business, Client, and Technology stakeholders to uphold data integrity, SLA compliance, and audit-ready documentation across US, Asia, LATAM, and CEEMEA.
CORE EXPERTISE
Project & Product Management — Full SDLC delivery across Agile and Waterfall, from initiation through UAT and go-live Financial Planning & Analysis — Budgeting, forecasting, reporting, reconciliation, and pricing analytics across global product lines Client Management — Senior stakeholder engagement at C-suite and Director level across multi-region, multi-time-zone programmes Business Process Re-engineering — Document Current and future-state workflow design, implement target operating model, drive automation, process standardization and operational efficiency improving client experience Cash Management — Deep knowledge of TWIST, EXCEL/BSB, and camt.086 standards; Global Billing report design and implementation Business & Data Analysis — Requirement Analysis, Gap Analysis, Data Analysis, and end-to-end testing (Unit, Functional, UAT) IT Change & Risk Governance — Operational risk reassessment against regulatory and technology-change requirements; AI-enabled process automation, education material, and compliance documentation

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
AVP - Senior Specialist, Business Technology Liaison Reconciliation | Bank of New York Mellon (BNY) | 03-01 2023 to 30-04- 2026
Strategic Leadership:
Led end-to-end daily, weekly, and monthly Cash, Position, and Digital Asset reconciliation transformation project across Custody, Fund Accounting, Middle Office, and AIS, for fixed income, financing, and related products. ensuring completion before trading-hour start for respective global regions. Managed new client onboarding, match and RAF rules validation on the reconciliation platform.
Change Transformation & Automation:
Led end-to-end TLM (Smart Stream) upgrade implementation, mapping, config set up, and support Drove reconciliation automation and AI-enabled capabilities initiative spanning multiple accounting & external system (Oracle GL, FTS, Geneva, GSP, Treasury Edge, Invest One/FIS), Transtar) reducing operational risk and manual data load.
Client Relationship Management:
Acted as primary liaison between Business, Client and technology team Recognized for process improvement expertise, Agile delivery, executive stakeholder management, and building high-performing teams that deliver transformative results.
Team Oversight & Coaching:
Managed and mentored a team of 6 junior analyst, overseeing multiple transformation initiatives within reconciliation, mentoring and coaching cross-functional operation team to foster professional growth and operational excellence.
Escalation Controls
Liaised with custodians on escalation matrix and resolving breaks, trade settlements and data load issues; maintained ongoing custodian relationships to uphold data integrity and SLA compliance. Managed and Established Feed Monitoring Dashboard product for tracking feed time discrepancy and data load issues for reconciliation, also performed Unknown Data Cleansing which accelerated early reconciliation and NAV calculation which helped business team to perform their daily task early.
Data migration and cleanup
Led end to end data cleanup for RDZ data platform leading to reduction of 10 million unknown data load to reconciliation platform and performed data migration project for reconciliation technology team from legacy system to new system. Expert in STP process integration and file interface configuration leading to removal of manual touch point.
Requirement Gathering and Test strategy:
Defined Business Requirement Documents, workflows, UAT, SIT test strategy, test cases, and validation criteria for internal and external data migration to the RDZ data platform via NDM/SFTP.
Project Artifacts:
Maintained project artifacts including charters, integrated timelines, RAID logs, and action item trackers across all reconciliation workstreams; documented user stories and process flow in JIRA and Confluence.
Risk Compliance and Governance:
Continually reassessed operational risks in line with regulatory requirements, operating procedures, and technology changes, applying change-governance discipline to escalation and oversight processes.
System Engineer - Lead Analyst | Tata Consultancy Services (Webster Bank Engagement) | 06-10- 2010 to 19-12- 2022
Business Advisory & Strategy:
Led end-to-end data migration from Central Data Repository (CDR / Oracle) to AWS-based Webster Data Repository (WDR) using Snowflake, ensuring data quality and regulatory compliance throughout.
Transformation Initiative:
Managed migration of SAP Business Objects reports to Tableau, delivering modern self-service BI capabilities for business users.
Requirement Gathering and Test strategy:
Defined business requirements, led UAT testing, and developed process flows to enhance system integration efficiency; provided training on new platform SOPs. Delivered cloud-based reporting architecture and modern BI capability, enabling data-driven decision-making across the organisation.
System Engineer - Project Manager, Global Billing Analytics (CIB) / Cash Operations | Tata Consultancy Services (Citibank) | 06-10- 2010 to 19-12- 2022
Leadership and Product Management
Led end-to-end ORMB product on boarding implementation and rollout activities within Trade and Treasury Solutions, serving as Subject Matter Expert for ISO 20022 Global Billing platform including TWIST XML/BSB, CAMT.086, EDI 822, and CSS format reports across US, Canada, Asia, LATAM, and CEEMEA regions.
Stakeholder Management
Acted as primary liaison between Business, Client and technology. Conducted walkthroughs and testing discussions with senior stakeholders, technology team during weekly and monthly business review calls. Responsible for preparation and timely presentation of varies reports such as, Cap Plan, MIS, KPI, Ad hoc Tracker and various audits documents and reports
Team Oversight & Coaching:
Led a team of 4 team members, fostering a culture of compliance, accountability, and operational excellence. Championed an inclusive mentoring culture across all staff levels, promoting skill development and engagement
UAT Test strategy:
Executed comprehensive UAT, SIT, Functional, and Regression testing cycles for ORMB and enterprise billing platforms, validating billing configurations, pricing calculations, invoicing workflows, payment processing, and financial transaction accuracy across multiple parallel environments. Defined test scope, reviewed business requirements, and coordinated defect resolution across SIT, UAT, and Regression phases in Agile/Scrum delivery models. Performed backend validation using Oracle SQL for billing data reconciliation and pricing accuracy checks; supported API and integration validation for billing system interfaces. Managed client onboarding, UAT sign-off coordination, and end-to-end validation for global billing invoices and reports, acting as primary liaison between Technology and Operations teams.
Transformation Re- engineering and automation
Led multiple platform re-engineering and automation initiatives across ORMB, GCAR, ECIF, Vanguard Big Data, IGS, and CRM notification distribution, significantly reducing manual reporting effort and improving data accuracy.
Root Cause Analysis & Process Enhancement:
Managed production support including issue triaging, root cause analysis, and release validation for Global Statements delivery, ensuring data integrity across multi-region billing operations. Reduced manual reporting effort, improved data accuracy, and enhanced client invoicing and reporting quality across 4+ global regions.
Workflow Specialist - Loss Mitigation | Tata Consultancy Services (CitiMortgage) | 06-10- 2010 to 19-12- 2022
Managed Citi Mortgage Loss Mitigation Program under FHA, VA, FHLMC, and FNMA guidelines; prepared MIS, KPI, and audit reports ensuring SLA compliance.
Trained and mentored new employees on loan modifications, HAMP, short sale programs, and financial documentation requirements.
Senior Customer Service Executive | Intelenet Global Services Pvt. Ltd. (Barclays Central Telephony) | 18 -12- 2006 to 01-10- 2010
Resolved inbound customer queries across Online Banking, Branch Banking, and Funds Transfers; mentored new joiners on COPC guidelines.
Awarded Best Advisor for 100% RBSM Quality Scores (Oct and Nov 2009).
Senior Customer Service Executive | Wipro BPO (Delta Airlines) | 21-02 2005 to 25-12- 2006
Handled reservations, cancellations, and ticket reissues; trained on IATA, Galileo, and CRM platforms. • Recognised as Rep of the Quarter (2005).
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Automated 76 manual reconciliation processes across TranStar, Eagle, FTS, Geneva, GSP, Treasury Edge, and Invest One at BNY Mellon, eliminating manual dependency and accelerating early reconciliation and NAV calculation for traders.
Managed Feed Monitoring Dashboard product development for tracking data load time issue faced by the business. • Led daily Cash, Position, and Digital Asset reconciliation cycles across Custody, Fund Accounting, Middle Office, and AIS workstreams, ensuring accuracy prior to trading-hour deadlines across global regions.
Managed onboarding for Turkey, Puerto Rico, UAE, Hong Kong, and Singapore on Oracle (ORMB) billing platform with zero data quality issues, demonstrating proven custodian relationship management.
Dr++ove TWIST Vanguard Big Data migration, ensuring data quality parity between new and legacy Linux-based environments.
Directed Unknown Data Cleansing initiative that significantly reduced 10 million unknown data loads to reconciliation platform, strengthening compliance posture and data governance.
Received direct client recognition for organisational excellence, backup data availability, and follow-through on complex reconciliation investigations.
Awarded Best Advisor (Barclays, Oct-Nov 2009) and Performer of the Month (Feb-Mar 2008); recognised as Rep of the Quarter (Wipro BPO, 2005) for performance excellence.
